hook: A job seeker finds out his interviewer is an AI, so *he sends his own AI* instead
caption:
This is a comedy skit, not a real interview: a candidate realizes his interviewer is an AI, lets his own AI take over and walks away.
The two AIs end up stuck saying goodbye to each other.
It is going viral because it is close to real: in a Greenhouse survey of 1,347 recruiters and hiring managers, more than half said they already use structured AI interviews, IBTimes UK reports.
